note: PROPOSAL. roles.add / roles.remove patch the output of features.mjs; "ability" is the intended reading for whoever writes the structured override.

cards.name: Spirit's Refuge
cards.text: When you play this, buff a friendly unit. / Friendly buffed units have [Deflect] if they didn't already.
cards.why: Clause "if they didn't already" is a no-op qualifier; the parse is otherwise right.
cards.ability: Treat as full.

cards.name: Kai'Sa, Evolutionary
cards.text: [Ganking] / When I conquer, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost less than your points without paying its Energy cost. Then recycle it.
cards.why: Free-cast of a spell from trash limited by "Energy cost less than your points".
cards.ability: trigger when-i-conquer; play spell from trash, energy free, filter energy < your points; then recycle it

cards.name: Promising Future
cards.text: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, banishes one of them, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs.
cards.why: Parsed in full on the errata text (banish one, recycle the rest, then each player plays the banished card). The effect is symmetric: every player gets the look and the free play.
cards.ability: each-player: look 5, banish 1, recycle rest; then each plays the banished card energy-free

cards.name: Baited Hook
cards.text: [1][Order], [Exhaust]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
cards.why: Sacrifice-and-upgrade: unit from top 5 with "Might up to 1 more than the killed unit".
cards.ability: activated {E1, order1, exhaust}: kill friendly unit (as effect); look 5; may play unit with might <= killed+1 free; recycle rest

cards.name: Divine Judgment
cards.text: Each player chooses 2 units, 2 gear, 2 runes, and 2 cards in their hands. Recycle the rest.
cards.why: Symmetric keep-N sweeper over units, gear, runes and hands.
cards.ability: each player keeps 2 units, 2 gear, 2 runes, 2 cards in hand; everything else is recycled

cards.name: Swift Scout
cards.text: You may pay [1] to hide a card with [Hidden] instead of [Rainbow]. / [1], [Exhaust]: Put a Teemo unit you own into your hand from your Champion Zone or the board.
cards.why: Returns a named champion ("a Teemo unit you own") from Champion Zone or board to hand.
cards.ability: static: alternative hide cost [1]; activated {E1, exhaust}: Teemo unit -> hand

cards.name: Hallowed Tomb
cards.text: When you hold here, you may return your Chosen Champion from your trash to your Champion Zone if it is empty.
cards.why: Chosen Champion from trash to Champion Zone.
cards.ability: trigger when-you-hold here; optional; condition Champion Zone empty

cards.name: Orianna, Mechanical Marvel
cards.text: Once each turn, while I'm at a battlefield, you may pay [1][Rainbow] less to play a gear.
cards.why: Cost reduction phrased as "you may pay ... less to play a gear", once each turn, while at a battlefield.
cards.ability: static cost-mod: gear, -[1][Rainbow], once each turn, condition at-battlefield

cards.name: Chronobreak
cards.text: As an additional cost to play this, pay any amount of Power. / Banish that many units you control, then for each, its owner plays that unit back to the same location or to their base, ignoring its cost.
cards.why: Variable-X blink: banish X of your units, owners replay them free.
cards.ability: additional cost: any amount of Power (X); banish X friendly units; each is replayed free to same location or base (re-triggers when-played abilities)

cards.name: Lady of Clockwork
cards.text: At the start of your Main Phase, you may pay [1] to choose a friendly gear. It becomes a unit gear with Might equal to its Energy cost until you choose another gear with me.
cards.why: Type-changing effect: a gear "becomes a unit gear with Might equal to its Energy cost".
cards.ability: trigger start-of-main; may pay [1]; chosen friendly gear is also a unit with might = its energy until another is chosen

cards.name: Starry-Eyed Songstress
cards.text: As an additional cost to play a spell, you may exhaust me and three friendly units to reduce the cost of that spell by [2].
cards.why: Cost reduction paid by exhausting the legend and three friendly units.
cards.ability: optional additional cost on any of your spells: exhaust me + 3 friendly units -> that spell costs [2] less

cards.name: Neeko, Blending In
cards.text: / If Neeko is in your deck, choose up to 3 different legends in addition to your starting legend. / When you play me, choose one of those Legends and add it to your Legend Zone while I'm on the board.
cards.why: Deckbuilding rule plus Legend Zone change. Errata text used (errata-texts.json). See rules.md 8.3.
cards.ability: deck rule: up to 3 extra legends; when-played: add one of them to Legend Zone while on board

cards.name: Svellsongur
cards.text: [Equip] [1][Calm] / As this is attached to a unit, copy that unit's text to this Equipment's effect text for as long as this is attached to it.
cards.why: Copies the equipped unit's text into its own effect text; what it does depends on the wearer.
cards.ability: cannot be scored statically; score per deck from the units it can equip

cards.name: Vex, Cheerless
cards.text: While I'm in combat, friendly spells cost [1][Rainbow] less to a minimum of [1], and enemy spells cost [1][Rainbow] more.
cards.why: Two-sided cost modifier with a floor, gated on being in combat.
cards.ability: static IF in-combat: friendly spells -[1][Rainbow] (min [1]); enemy spells +[1][Rainbow]

cards.name: Soraka, Wanderer
cards.text: I must be assigned combat damage last. / If another unit you control here would die, if it has less Might than me, instead heal it, exhaust it, and recall it.
cards.why: Death replacement for another unit with a Might comparison; the recall is part of the save, not movement.
cards.ability: replacement @would-die (other friendly unit here, might < mine): heal, exhaust, recall

cards.name: Tricksy Tentacles
cards.text: Move any number of enemy units with the same controller and a total Might of 8 or less to a single location.
cards.why: Target set limited by "same controller" and "total Might of 8 or less".
cards.ability: move any number of enemy units (one controller, total might <= 8) to one location

cards.name: Decree of Focus
cards.text: [Reaction] / Choose a friendly unit that's in combat with an enemy Fury unit or that's being chosen by an enemy Fury spell. Give it +4 [Might] this turn.
cards.why: Target must be in combat with an enemy Fury unit or chosen by an enemy Fury spell.
cards.ability: conditional combat trick (+4 Might this turn), only versus Fury

cards.name: Mel, Newly Awakened
cards.text: When you play me, draw 1. / [Empower] [3] / [Empowered][>] Your spells and abilities can't be countered. If a spell or ability you control would give -[Might] to a unit it chooses, it gives an additional -1 [Might].
cards.why: Replacement that increases -Might effects by 1.
cards.ability: Empowered: your spells/abilities cannot be countered; your -Might effects give an additional -1

cards.name: Gangplank, Naval
cards.text: [Empower] [Body][Body] / [Empowered][>] If a spell or ability that chooses me would stun me, give me -[Might], or return me to hand, give me +3 [Might] this turn instead.
cards.why: Self-protection replacement (stun / -Might / return to hand become +3 Might this turn; errata text).
cards.ability: Empowered replacement on self

cards.name: Shady Spectacles
cards.text: [Equip] [1][Order] / As this is attached to a unit, choose another friendly unit. The equipped unit becomes a copy of that unit for as long as this is attached to it.
cards.why: Equipped unit "becomes a copy of" another friendly unit.
cards.ability: cannot be scored statically

cards.name: Rogue Assassin
cards.text: [Empower] [3][Rainbow] / [Action][>] [Exhaust]: If it's your turn, move a friendly unit in a showdown to base and if I'm [Empowered], ready it.
cards.why: Nested condition ("if I'm Empowered, ready it") inside an activated ability.
cards.ability: activated <action> {exhaust}: your turn only; move friendly unit in a showdown to base; if Empowered ready it

cards.name: Dragon Roost
cards.text: Any player may pay [Rainbow][Rainbow] as an additional cost to play a Dragon. If they do, they play it to this battlefield.
cards.why: Any player may pay an additional cost to play a Dragon to this battlefield.
cards.ability: symmetric play-permission for Dragon units, cost [Rainbow][Rainbow]

cards.name: Mystic Vortex
cards.text: During showdowns here, cards with [Reaction] cost [Rainbow] more to play.
cards.why: Tax on cards with [Reaction] during showdowns here.
cards.ability: static tax, symmetric

cards.name: Risen Altar
cards.text: [Empower] costs of your units here cost [1] or [Rainbow] less.
cards.why: Reduces [Empower] costs of your units here.
cards.ability: static cost-mod on Empower costs, -[1] or -[Rainbow]

cards.name: Otterpus
cards.text: If a player would score 1 point from conquering or holding during their first or second turn, they draw 1 instead.
cards.why: Symmetric replacement of early points by a draw (parsed with both conditions since iteration 3); the draw goes to whoever would have scored, so it is not card flow for its owner.
cards.ability: replacement @would-score (any player, turns 1-2, conquer/hold): that player draws 1 instead

cards.name: Shakedown
cards.text: [Reaction] / Choose an enemy unit. Deal 6 to it unless its controller has you draw 2.

roles.note: removal_single and card_flow are both opponent-choice

cards.why: Punisher: the opponent chooses between taking 6 and letting you draw 2. Neither outcome is guaranteed.
cards.ability: deal 6 to enemy unit UNLESS its controller has you draw 2

cards.name: Gust Monk
cards.text: You may pay [1] as an additional cost to play me. / When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, banish a card from any trash to give a unit [Assault 2] this turn.
cards.why: "banish a card from any trash to give ..." is a cost-shaped clause, so the trash hate is not seen.
cards.ability: when-played IF paid: banish a card from any trash; a unit gets Assault 2 this turn

cards.name: Lulu, Whimsical
cards.text: When I move, you may have another unit's base Might become 4 this turn.
cards.why: Sets another unit's base Might to 4: a buff or a shrink depending on the target.
cards.ability: when-i-move: may set another unit's base Might to 4 this turn

cards.name: Heimerdinger, Inventor
cards.text: I have all [Exhaust] abilities of all friendly legends, units, and gear.
cards.why: Has all [Exhaust] abilities of all friendly legends, units and gear.
cards.ability: cannot be scored statically

cards.name: Mirror Image
cards.text: Choose a unit. Play a ready Reflection unit token to your base. Then do this: It becomes a copy of that unit. Give it [Temporary].
cards.why: Reflection token becomes a copy of a chosen unit.
cards.ability: value depends on the copied unit

cards.name: Zilean, Time Mage
cards.text: Once each turn, if you would play a token unit while I'm at a battlefield, you may play that token and an additional copy of it instead.
cards.why: Doubles token-unit plays; the token is whatever the other card makes.
cards.ability: replacement @would-play token unit, once each turn, while at a battlefield

cards.name: Cursed Sarcophagus
cards.text: When you play this, banish all units from your trash. / [Exhaust]: Play a unit banished with this.
cards.why: Reanimation through an intermediate zone: banishes all units from your trash, then plays "a unit banished with this".
cards.ability: when-played: banish all units from your trash; activated {exhaust}: play a unit banished with this

cards.name: Undertitan
cards.text: When you play me, give your other units +2 [Might] this turn. / As I'm revealed from your deck, [Add] [2].

roles.note: rune_ramp is conditional on reveal effects

cards.why: The [Add] happens only "as I'm revealed from your deck"; it is not a repeatable resource source.

cards.name: Aspirant's Climb
cards.text: Increase the points needed to win the game by 1.
cards.why: Changes the points needed to win; no scorer role fits.

cards.name: Endless Riches
cards.text: When you play this, banish your hand and trash, then [Burn 7]. / Skip your Draw Phase. / You may play cards from your trash. / If a card would go to your trash from anywhere other than your Main Deck, banish it instead.

roles.note: recursion via permission; treat as build-around

cards.why: Whole-card engine: banish hand and trash, burn 7, skip draws, play from trash.

tokens.note: All 12 tokens are defined by the Core Rules and parsed in full by build-tokens.mjs; no hand-written token definition is needed. Join on the token name in roles.token_maker.
